title: Dummy Plus
description: Disconnecting spawns a villager/zombie with the players username and if this dummy is killed, the players loot is dropped
body:
# 💀 Dummy Plus

**Dummy Plus** adds consequences to logging out. When players disconnect, a dummy spawns with their inventory, if the dummy is destroyed, the player dies and loses everything upon rejoining.

## ✨ Features

### 🎯 Logout System
- **Dummies**: Player dummies spawn at logout locations with 10 health points
- **Inventory**: Dummies carry the player's entire inventory
- **Death**: If the dummy dies the player dies and loses everything upon rejoining
- **Smart Spawning**: Only spawns on player logouts, no dummies on kicks or crashes

### 🎨 Customization
- **Entity**: Choose between Villager or Zombie dummy appearances
- **Color-Coded Names**: 16 different name colors with bold formatting
- **GUI Configuration**: Easy settings menu for server customization
- **Real-time Updates**: Changes apply to all active dummies immediately

## 🎮 Commands & Permissions

- `/dummy edit` - Open configuration GUI (requires `dummyplus.edit`)

## ⚙️ Configuration

Customize through config.yml:
```yaml
# Dummy entity type (VILLAGER or ZOMBIE)
dummy-entity: "VILLAGER"

name-color: "RED"
